- Initial release of rm-safety skill for high-risk command protection.
- Intercepts and requires user confirmation before executing dangerous file deletion commands (e.g., rm, unlink, shred).
- Provides detailed impact assessment and safer alternatives when such commands are detected.
- Does not trigger for recoverable delete actions (trash, mv to trash).
- Includes exception handling and clear instructions for user responses.
